firstRecord.quote: Fictional workshop record A: cards stamped with water-based ink were tested at 18 °C. The recorded median drying time was 90 seconds.

secondRecord.quote: Workshop record B: cards stamped with gel ink were tested at 26 °C. The recorded median drying time was 60 seconds. The original run log does not report sample sizes or individual readings.

designRecord.quote: Planning brief for a new test, not collected results: investigate ink formula while controlling room temperature. There are 32 fresh cards; one card is an experimental unit and can receive either ink. Retain the same card stock, stamped area and ink volume. The outcome is drying time in seconds. Measurement rule: start timing at stamping, then press a fresh clean test strip lightly at five-second intervals until no ink transfers; record that elapsed time for each card. The available temperature settings are 18 °C and 26 °C.

controls.quote: Retain the same card stock, stamped area and ink volume.

measurement.quote: start timing at stamping, then press a fresh clean test strip lightly at five-second intervals until no ink transfers; record that elapsed time for each card.

secondRecord.quote: 记录乙：不带保温套的一组杯子，起始水温为30 °C，十分钟后的温度为27 °C。旧记录没有提供每组杯数和每杯读数。

designRecord.quote: 新试验的准备条件，尚未实施：研究保温套，同时控制起始水温。可用24只同款新杯子；一只杯子是一个实验单位，每只均可加上或不加保温套。保留相同杯型、每杯200 mL水量和相同室内环境。结果指标为十分钟内温度下降值。测量规则：用同一校准规则的温度计记录每杯开始时与十分钟后的摄氏温度，以起始值减去结束值，逐杯保存。可选择的起始水温为40 °C或30 °C。
